Class TradeStockDialog

java.lang.Object
edu.ntnu.idi.idatt2003.millions.view.dialog.MillionsDialog
edu.ntnu.idi.idatt2003.millions.view.dialog.TradeStockDialog
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuyStockDialog, SellStockDialog
public abstract class TradeStockDialog extends MillionsDialog
Base dialog for trade operations that share quantity input and total calculation UI.
